paper.title: A low-cost sensor for river nitrate

paper_text:
A low-cost sensor for river nitrate
Novak, P., Silva, R.  J. Fake Environmental Science, 2018

Abstract
We describe a sensor costing under 20 USD that measures nitrate in river water to within 5% of lab results.

Methods
The calibration protocol is given in Section 2.
